data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2025 – Refund of €793.00
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterhafen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 dated 21.05.2026, setting income tax at €4,402.00 against €5,195.00 withheld wage tax, resulting in a refund of €793.00 to be paid out to the known account.
data.explanation: This letter from the tax office (Finanzamt) finalizes your 2025 income tax and shows you overpaid, so you will receive a refund (Erstattung) of €793.00 automatically to your known bank account within the next days — no action needed on the payment. If you disagree with the calculation, you can file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office, in writing or electronically, by the deadline shown (calculated from when the letter is deemed received). If you take no action, the assessment becomes final. Keep this notice for your tax records.
